milestones.title: Sprint 1
milestones.description: 18-21 Aug - Auth core and booking domain

milestones.title: Sprint 2
milestones.description: 24-27 Aug - Public browsing and the money trail

milestones.title: Sprint 3
milestones.description: 31 Aug-3 Sep - Tenant CRUD and tenant transactions

milestones.title: Sprint 4
milestones.description: 7-10 Sep - Pricing engine, emails and reviews

milestones.title: Review
milestones.description: 18-23 Sep - Bug fixes, deployment and slides

issues.title: [F1] Scaffold the auth module and validation schemas
issues.goal: Create the auth module skeleton so every later auth task drops into a consistent structure.
acceptance: auth.routes, auth.controller, auth.service and auth.schema files exist and are wired into src/routes/index.ts
Zod schemas cover register, verify, login, refresh and reset payloads
Every handler is wrapped in asyncHandler and returns the shared ApiResponse envelope

issues.title: [F1] User and tenant registration endpoints
issues.goal: Let both account types register with an email address and no password, per the spec.
acceptance: POST /auth/register/user and POST /auth/register/tenant accept different payloads
Tenant registration also creates the TenantProfile row
A duplicate email returns 409 and never leaks whether the account is verified
Registration sends the verification email and does not accept a password

issues.title: [F1] Email verification with set password
issues.goal: Verify the account and capture the first password in a single step.
acceptance: The link expires 60 minutes after it is sent and can only be used once (usedAt)
Only the SHA-256 digest of the token is stored
Password is hashed with bcrypt before it is written
The user is asked to log in again after verifying
POST /auth/resend-verification works for unverified accounts only

issues.title: [F1] Login, refresh and logout with JWT
issues.goal: Issue and rotate tokens so every guarded route has an identity to check.
acceptance: POST /auth/login returns an access token, a refresh token and the AuthUser payload
Wrong credentials return a generic message that does not reveal which field was wrong
POST /auth/refresh rotates the access token
A tenant token cannot be used on user-only routes and vice versa

issues.title: [F1] Registration and login pages for user and tenant
issues.goal: Give each role its own registration and login screen, as the spec requires separate pages.
acceptance: Four pages exist: register user, register tenant, login user, login tenant
Client-side validation mirrors the server Zod rules
After login each role is redirected to its own landing area
Mobile-first layout, works down to 360px wide

issues.title: [F1] Verification page, session store and route guards
issues.goal: Hold the session on the client and stop unauthorised users reaching protected pages.
acceptance: Verification page accepts the token, collects a password and confirms it
Session is persisted and restored on reload, with token refresh on 401
Unauthenticated visits to protected pages redirect to the homepage
Unverified users see a banner and transaction actions are disabled, not hidden

issues.title: [F2] Scaffold the booking module and validation schemas
issues.goal: Create the booking module skeleton and shared Zod schemas.
acceptance: bookings.routes, controller, service and schema files exist and are wired into the router
Zod schemas cover quote, create, list query, cancel and confirm payloads
List query schema coerces page, limit, dates and enforces the max limit

issues.title: [F2] Booking quote endpoint
issues.goal: Price a stay before a booking row exists so checkout can show a breakdown.
acceptance: POST /bookings/quote returns per-night prices, the night count and the total
Uses services/pricing.service rather than recomputing prices
Unavailable dates are listed so the UI can mark them
Guest count above room capacity is rejected

issues.title: [F2] Create reservation with per-night price snapshot
issues.goal: Turn a quote into a booking that holds inventory and freezes its pricing.
acceptance: POST /bookings writes the Booking plus one BookingNight per night in a transaction
Availability is re-checked inside the transaction to avoid double booking
Status starts at WAITING_PAYMENT with paymentDeadline set from PAYMENT_DEADLINE_MINUTES
Only verified users can create a booking
Total price equals the sum of the night snapshots

issues.title: [F2] Order number generator and status state machine
issues.goal: Centralise legal status transitions so no endpoint can move a booking illegally.
acceptance: Order numbers follow INP-YYYYMMDD-NNNN and are unique
A single canTransition helper defines every allowed status move
Illegal transitions throw a 409 with a readable message
The transition table matches the diagram in docs/ERD.md

issues.title: [F2] Auto-cancel job for unpaid bookings
issues.goal: Release rooms when a guest never uploads payment proof in time.
acceptance: expire-unpaid-bookings cancels WAITING_PAYMENT bookings past their deadline
cancelledBy is set to SYSTEM and a reason is recorded
The job is idempotent and safe to run every five minutes
Runs locally through node-cron and remotely through POST /api/cron/expire-unpaid-bookings

issues.title: [F2] Booking detail endpoint with ownership scoping
issues.goal: Return one booking with everything the detail screen needs.
acceptance: GET /bookings/:orderNumber returns the night breakdown and computed action flags
A guest can only read their own booking
A tenant can only read bookings for properties they own
canBeCancelled, canUploadPaymentProof and canBeReviewed are computed server-side

issues.title: [F1] Property catalog endpoint with server-side paging, filter and sort
issues.goal: Power the search results page entirely from the server, as the spec demands.
acceptance: GET /properties filters by city, date range, guests, category and price range
Sorts by name and price, ascending and descending
Paginates on the server and returns the shared PaginationMeta
startingPrice is the cheapest available room for the requested dates
Properties with no availability in the range are excluded

issues.title: [F1] Property detail endpoint
issues.goal: Return one property with its rooms so checkout has something to start from.
acceptance: GET /properties/:slug returns images, rooms, tenant name, rating and review count
Each room carries its resolved price for the requested dates
Soft-deleted properties and rooms are excluded
Returns 404 for an unknown slug

issues.title: [F1] Monthly room price calendar endpoint
issues.goal: Let guests compare prices across dates, which is the core idea of the product.
acceptance: GET /properties/:id/calendar returns every day of the requested month
Each day carries basePrice, finalPrice, availability and the adjustment that applied
Uses services/pricing.service so it never disagrees with the quote endpoint
Unavailable days are flagged rather than omitted

issues.title: [F1] Landing page shell: navbar, hero carousel and footer
issues.goal: Build the first screen a visitor sees.
acceptance: Navbar holds the main menu and adapts to signed-in, signed-out, user and tenant states
Hero section is a carousel of promotional slides
Footer carries supporting links and company information
Mobile-first, verified at 360px, 768px and 1280px

issues.title: [F1] Search form: destination, dates, duration and guests
issues.goal: Collect the search criteria the spec requires before showing any listings.
acceptance: Destination is a dropdown of available cities loaded from the API
Dates are chosen from a calendar, with check-out after check-in enforced
Duration and guest count are captured and validated
Submitting pushes the criteria into the results URL so the search is shareable

issues.title: [F1] Catalog results and property detail pages
issues.goal: Let a guest browse results and land on a property they want to book.
acceptance: Results page renders server-driven pagination, filters and sorting
Loading skeletons and an empty state are handled
Detail page shows the gallery, room list and the monthly price calendar
Each room card links into the checkout flow with dates already applied

issues.title: [F2] Payment proof upload endpoint
issues.goal: Accept a transfer receipt and move the booking forward.
acceptance: POST /bookings/:id/payment-proof accepts only .jpg and .png, max 1MB
Status moves to WAITING_CONFIRMATION and paymentProofUploadedAt is set
Uploading after the deadline or in the wrong status is rejected
Only the booking owner can upload

issues.title: [F2] User order list endpoint
issues.goal: Let guests find their own bookings, in progress or finished.
acceptance: GET /bookings paginates, filters by status and sorts on the server
Search by order number and by date range works
Only the signed-in user's bookings are returned
Response uses the shared Paginated envelope

issues.title: [F2] User cancel order endpoint
issues.goal: Allow a guest to back out before they have paid.
acceptance: Cancelling is only allowed while no payment proof has been uploaded
Any later attempt returns 409 with a clear reason
cancelledBy is set to USER and the nights are released
The tenant receives a notification

issues.title: [F2] Checkout page with price breakdown
issues.goal: Turn a selected room and date range into a confirmed reservation.
acceptance: Shows the per-night breakdown from the quote endpoint, including peak season nights
Guest count and dates can be adjusted and the quote refreshes
Unverified users are blocked with an explanation and a resend link
On success the user lands on the order detail page

issues.title: [F2] Order list page with filters and search
issues.goal: Give guests one place to track every booking.
acceptance: Status tabs, date range filter and order number search all drive server queries
Pagination controls reflect the server meta
Each row shows status in Indonesian using BOOKING_STATUS_LABEL
Empty and loading states are handled

issues.title: [F2] Order detail page with upload and payment countdown
issues.goal: Show one booking and every action available on it right now.
acceptance: Displays the night breakdown, total and current status
Payment proof upload validates type and size before sending
A live countdown shows the remaining payment window
Cancel is only offered when the server says it is allowed, with a confirmation dialog

issues.title: [F1] Property category CRUD
issues.goal: Let tenants define their own property categories.
acceptance: Create, list, update and soft-delete endpoints exist under /tenant/categories
A tenant only ever sees and edits their own categories
Slugs are unique per tenant
Deleting a category that still has properties is refused

issues.title: [F1] Property CRUD with image upload
issues.goal: Let tenants publish and maintain their listings.
acceptance: Create, update and soft-delete endpoints enforce tenant ownership
Required fields are name, category, description, picture and at least one room
Images validate extension and size and go through libs/cloudinary
Slug is generated and stays unique

issues.title: [F1] Room CRUD
issues.goal: Let a property offer several room types, each with its own price.
acceptance: Create, update and soft-delete endpoints nested under a property
Required fields are name, price, description, capacity and total units
Only the owning tenant can modify a room
A room with active bookings cannot be hard-deleted

issues.title: [F1] Tenant property list page
issues.goal: Give tenants an overview of everything they rent out.
acceptance: Lists the tenant's properties with their rooms nested underneath
Server-side pagination, search and sorting
Row actions for edit, manage rooms and delete
Delete asks for confirmation first

issues.title: [F1] Property create and edit form with image manager
issues.goal: Provide the form tenants use to publish a property.
acceptance: All required fields validated on the client before submitting
Multiple images can be uploaded, reordered and removed, with previews
Extension and size are checked before the request is sent
Works as both a create and an edit screen

issues.title: [F1] Room form and category management UI
issues.goal: Manage rooms and categories without leaving the tenant area.
acceptance: Room create and edit forms cover name, price, description, capacity and units
Category management supports create, rename and delete inline
Destructive actions confirm first
Validation errors from the server are shown against the right field

issues.title: [F2] Tenant order list endpoint
issues.goal: Let tenants work through incoming bookings by status.
acceptance: GET /tenant/bookings paginates, filters by status and property, and sorts on the server
Only bookings for the caller's own properties are returned
Search by order number and guest name works
Each row exposes whether it is awaiting a confirmation decision

issues.title: [F2] Confirm or reject payment proof
issues.goal: Give tenants the decision step the spec describes.
acceptance: Accepting moves the booking to PROCESSED and stamps confirmedAt
Rejecting returns it to WAITING_PAYMENT with a reason and a fresh deadline
Only the owning tenant can decide, and only from WAITING_CONFIRMATION
The guest is notified either way

issues.title: [F2] Tenant cancel order endpoint
issues.goal: Let tenants drop a booking that was never paid for.
acceptance: Only allowed while no payment proof has been uploaded
cancelledBy is set to TENANT and a reason is stored
The nights are released for rebooking
The guest receives a notification

issues.title: [F2] Notification endpoints
issues.goal: Surface in-app notifications for booking events.
acceptance: GET /notifications paginates the caller's notifications
Mark-one-read and mark-all-read endpoints exist
A createNotification helper is reused by the booking service
Unread count is available for the header badge

issues.title: [F2] Tenant transactions page
issues.goal: Give tenants one screen to process every incoming booking.
acceptance: Status tabs backed by server-side queries and pagination
Payment proof opens in a preview dialog before a decision is made
Accept and reject both confirm first, and reject captures a reason
The list refreshes optimistically after a decision

issues.title: [F2] Notification bell and list
issues.goal: Tell users about booking events without making them refresh.
acceptance: Header bell shows an unread count
Dropdown lists recent notifications and marks them read on open
Each notification deep-links to the related booking
Works for both user and tenant headers

issues.title: [F1] Room availability management endpoints
issues.goal: Let tenants close or reopen dates for a room.
acceptance: PUT /tenant/rooms/:id/availability sets a date range available or blocked
Available unit count can be reduced below totalUnits for a range
Blocking a date that already has bookings is refused with a clear message
Only the owning tenant can change availability

issues.title: [F1] Peak season rate CRUD
issues.goal: Let tenants raise prices on long weekends and public holidays.
acceptance: Create, list, update and delete rates for a room
Both NOMINAL and PERCENTAGE adjustments are supported
A rate can cover a whole range or a single date
End date before start date is rejected

issues.title: [Shared] Extend the pricing resolver for overlapping rate windows
issues.goal: Settle what happens when two peak season windows cover the same night.
acceptance: The precedence rule is documented in the file header
Percentage and nominal adjustments both round to whole rupiah
Feature 2 quote, calendar and booking snapshots all agree on the same number
Reviewed and approved by both contributors

issues.title: [F1] Availability calendar management UI
issues.goal: Let a tenant manage availability by clicking a calendar.
acceptance: Month calendar per room showing open, blocked and booked days
A date range can be selected and toggled in one action
Days with existing bookings are visibly locked
Changes confirm before saving

issues.title: [F1] Peak season rate management UI
issues.goal: Make seasonal pricing easy to set up and easy to read back.
acceptance: Form captures name, date range, adjustment type and value
A live preview shows the resulting nightly price
Existing rates are listed with edit and delete, delete confirms first
Percentage and nominal inputs validate their own ranges

issues.title: [F1] Show real pricing and availability in the detail calendar
issues.goal: Deliver the price comparison across dates that the product is built around.
acceptance: The public calendar shows the resolved price on every day of the month
Unavailable days are clearly marked as such
Peak season days are visually distinct from base-price days
Picking a date range updates the checkout link

issues.title: [F2] Booking confirmed email with detail and house rules
issues.goal: Email the guest everything they need once their payment is accepted.
acceptance: Sent automatically when a tenant accepts a payment proof
Contains booking detail, total paid and the property rules
Uses the booking-confirmed Handlebars template
A send failure is logged and never rolls back the confirmation

issues.title: [F2] H-1 check-in reminder job
issues.goal: Remind guests the day before their stay starts.
acceptance: Finds PROCESSED bookings with check-in tomorrow
reminderSentAt prevents a second email if the job runs again
Uses the checkin-reminder template
Runs from node-cron locally and Vercel Cron in production

issues.title: [F2] Create review endpoint
issues.goal: Let guests review a property once they have actually stayed.
acceptance: Only allowed after the check-out date has passed
Exactly one review per booking, enforced by the unique constraint
Only the guest who made the booking can review it
Rating range and comment length are validated

issues.title: [F2] Review list and tenant reply endpoints
issues.goal: Show reviews publicly and let tenants respond once.
acceptance: GET /properties/:id/reviews paginates public reviews with replies
A tenant can reply once per review, only on their own properties
Average rating and review count are exposed for the catalog
The reviewer is notified when a reply arrives

issues.title: [F2] Review submission UI
issues.goal: Prompt guests to review after they check out.
acceptance: Completed orders show a review action only when canBeReviewed is true
Rating and comment are validated before submitting
After submitting, the action is replaced by the saved review
Already-reviewed bookings never show the form again

issues.title: [F2] Property review list and tenant reply UI
issues.goal: Show reviews on the property page and let tenants answer them.
acceptance: Public review list paginates on the property detail page
Average rating is shown alongside the review count
Tenant area lists reviews awaiting a reply and supports replying inline
Empty state reads well when a property has no reviews yet

issues.title: [F1] Reset password request and confirm endpoints
issues.goal: Let email-registered users recover their account.
acceptance: Requesting a reset emails a single-use link that expires in an hour
The response is identical whether or not the email exists
Social-login accounts are refused with an explanation
Confirming sets a new hashed password and burns the token

issues.title: [F1] Profile endpoints: details, avatar, email and password
issues.goal: Let both roles maintain their own account.
acceptance: Read and update personal details, plus the tenant company profile
Avatar accepts .jpg, .jpeg, .png and .gif up to 1MB only
Changing the email sets isVerified to false and sends a new verification link
Changing the password requires the current password

issues.title: [F1] Google social login
issues.goal: Offer the social login path the spec asks for.
acceptance: Google sign-in works for both registration and login
Social accounts are created already verified with provider set to GOOGLE
An email already registered with a password cannot be silently taken over
Reset password is disabled for social accounts

issues.title: [F1] Reset password pages
issues.goal: Build the two screens the reset flow needs.
acceptance: Request page collects the email and always shows the same confirmation
Confirm page collects and confirms the new password
An expired or used token shows a helpful message with a way to retry
Both pages are mobile-first

issues.title: [F1] User and tenant profile pages
issues.goal: Give each role a place to manage their account.
acceptance: Separate profile screens for user and tenant
Avatar upload previews and validates before sending
Email change warns that re-verification is required
Unverified accounts see a resend-verification action

issues.title: [F1] Responsive pass over Feature 1 screens
issues.goal: Meet the mobile-first requirement across every Feature 1 page.
acceptance: Every Feature 1 screen checked at 360px, 768px and 1280px
No horizontal scrolling and no overlapping content
Tap targets are large enough on mobile
Tables and calendars degrade sensibly on small screens

issues.title: [F2] Sales report endpoint
issues.goal: Tell tenants what they earned and where it came from.
acceptance: Group by property, transaction or user
Filter by date range, sort by date or total revenue
Revenue aggregates BookingNight snapshots, not current prices
Only the caller's own properties are included

issues.title: [F2] Property availability report endpoint
issues.goal: Show occupancy per room as a calendar.
acceptance: Returns each room's days for a month with booked, available and blocked counts
Scoped to the caller's own properties
Handles rooms with multiple units correctly
Month parameter is validated

issues.title: [F2] Sales report page
issues.goal: Make the sales numbers readable at a glance.
acceptance: Grouping switch for property, transaction and user
Date range filter and sorting drive server queries
Summary cards show total revenue, booking count and average value
Currency is formatted as rupiah and the empty state reads well

issues.title: [F2] Property report calendar page
issues.goal: Let tenants see occupancy per room month by month.
acceptance: Calendar per room with booked, available and blocked days colour-coded
Property and month selectors reload the data
A legend explains the colours
Readable on mobile

issues.title: [F2] Complete bookings after check-out
issues.goal: Move finished stays to COMPLETED so reviews unlock.
acceptance: A daily job moves PROCESSED bookings past their check-out date to COMPLETED
The job is idempotent
canBeReviewed becomes true once the booking completes
Registered in the job registry and in vercel.json

issues.title: [F2] Responsive pass over Feature 2 screens
issues.goal: Meet the mobile-first requirement across every Feature 2 page.
acceptance: Every Feature 2 screen checked at 360px, 768px and 1280px
Order and report tables are usable on mobile
Dialogs and upload controls work with touch
No horizontal scrolling

issues.title: [Review] Feature 1 clean-code and standardization pass
issues.goal: Meet the standardization checklist the judges score against.
acceptance: Every Feature 1 file is under 200 lines and every function under 15 lines
No leftover console logs or unused code
Every list paginates, filters and sorts on the server
Client and server validation present on every input

issues.title: [Review] Feature 2 clean-code and standardization pass
issues.goal: Meet the standardization checklist the judges score against.
acceptance: Every Feature 2 file is under 200 lines and every function under 15 lines
No leftover console logs or unused code
REST methods and status codes follow convention
Authorization verified on every tenant-scoped endpoint

issues.title: [Review] Title, favicon, metadata and error pages
issues.goal: Finish the presentation details that are explicitly graded.
acceptance: Favicon and per-page titles match the project
Open Graph metadata is set for sharing
Custom 404 and error pages exist
Loading and empty states are consistent across the app

issues.title: [Review] Deploy to Vercel on inapyuk.space
issues.goal: Put the finished app on the domain for the presentation.
acceptance: Web deployed to inapyuk.space and API to api.inapyuk.space
Environment variables set in Vercel for both projects
Vercel Cron jobs firing against the protected cron endpoints
Neon production database migrated and seeded with demo data

issues.title: [Review] Feature 1 slides and demo script
issues.goal: Prepare the Feature 1 half of the final presentation.
acceptance: Slides cover group name, project spec, user flow, task split and references
A rehearsed demo path covers registration through property management
Screenshots or recordings are ready as a fallback
Submitted to the academic and operational emails by D-1

issues.title: [Review] Feature 2 slides and demo script
issues.goal: Prepare the Feature 2 half of the final presentation.
acceptance: Slides cover the transaction lifecycle, reviews and reports
A rehearsed demo path covers booking through tenant confirmation to the sales report
Seeded demo data prepared so every status can be shown
Submitted to the academic and operational emails by D-1
